element.reason: usage-v2.json with the bundled shadcn-aria/example@4.23.0 harness restored to its stock bytes: it imports cn from the shadcn cn package, as the vendored item ships it (dependencies: cn) and as shadcn add writes it (the add-time rewrite touches only @/ and # specifiers). The @/lib/utils rewrite and its two import-paths adaptations are dropped, so the harness is byte-identical stock.
